verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at maritime.sh/llms.txt (HTTP 200). Maritime also publishes a CLI-specific llms.txt with explicit agent instructions and a dedicated AI-agents docs page that says the CLI is built to be operated by other agents, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. missing for 10: markdown renditions of the docs (docs.md returned 404), machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://maritime.sh/llms.txt # Maritime
Pass --json on EVERY command. Success: one JSON value on stdout, stderr empty.
The Maritime CLI is built to be operated by other AI agents, not just humans: machine-readable output on every command, stable exit codes, and a live self-describing contract.
Paste one prompt into Claude, Cursor, or any assistant and it can install the CLI, authenticate, and deploy agents for you.
